label: There is no infinite chain in which each member is moved in local MOTION_2 by…, from PER_SE_1…
description: The prima via's regress premises entail Physics VII.1's restricted regress. Not a transcription: induction on accessibility, and premisesNeeded shows both premises are needed. restrictedRegressIsWeaker shows the converse fails even with the second-movers premise: with no local respects there is no local chain, while the per se series is infinite. So VII.1's conclusion is a weaker reading that survives, and it cannot discharge STMT-NO-INFINITE-PER-SE-MOVER-SERIES. Connects results; closes nothing.
